notes.title: Damned 2 Update – The Blood Oracle
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Everyone![/h2][p][/p][p]We are happy to announce that our first content update for Damned 2 is now live!  [/p][p][/p][p]This update brings one of the biggest new mechanics so far: the [b]Blood Oracle[/b]. Survivors can now sacrifice the [b]Heart[/b] at the [b]Blood Altar[/b] to summon the [b]Blood Whisper[/b], a spectral guide that points to the next missing item. It’s a way to help when progress stalls, while still keeping the tension high because the [b]monster can[/b] [b]see the Heart and hears your voice chat while you’re carrying it[/b]. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221390/Damned_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]New Feature: Blood Oracle [/h2][h3]Blood Altar[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/21475bd2f5357384df1aa76786e188354cf08c93.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Assists survivors in finding lost items by summoning the Blood Whisper.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors must locate the Sacrificial Heart and place it on the altar.[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters cannot see or collide with the altar.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]The Sacrificial Heart[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/eb9423d8ba974ffca6141ba041a63f56edda27be.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Spawns in one of the already opened rooms a few minutes into a match.[/p][/*][*][p]The altar can reveal the Heart’s location or show the timer for the next spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]When active, the Heart emits a global directional heartbeat and moves around the map.[/p][/*][*][p]If carried, the monster can [b]see the Heart and hear the carrier’s VOIP[/b], and the AI becomes aware of the holder.[/p][/*][*][p]If not picked up within 3 minutes, the Heart respawns in another room.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]The Blood Whisper[/h3][list][*][p]Slowly guides survivors to the next key or puzzle item.[/p][/*][*][p]Will not appear if survivors already hold an unused key or if there are unsolved puzzles, though the altar will still point to what’s missing.[/p][/*][*][p]Disappears once the guided item is collected; then a new Heart spawns.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Available Difficulty Modes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Beginner[/b] – First Heart at 4 minutes; new Heart spawns 1 minute after the last item is collected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Normal[/b] – First Heart at 5 minutes; new Heart spawns 3 minutes later.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Limited[/b] – First Heart at 7 minutes; new Hearts spawn 5 minutes later. Limited to 2 total.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No Altar[/b] – Removes all altars from the map.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Banners[/h2][p]4 New banners for you to collect. [/p][list][*][p][b]The Heart[/b]: Use the Blood Oracle 4 times.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/67d6b151c3ee484dca268c58cff4638830de5838.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Blood Altar[/b]: Use the Blood Oracle 13 times in a match with the Normal Preset against a monster.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/7d2a61eddf8402a7b024d9c6f326b7b25a3a57b9.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Blood God[/b]: With 4 survivors, win using the Impossible Preset against Mary AI on Rose Crimson, and activate the Blood Altar 2 times during the match.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/1959fb4243fff4aefb7b1021eae2eae60426d2c8.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Host of the Damned[/b]: Complete 20 games in a public lobby.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/c6372b65bb8caad3e7e0d41bc3fa4bb77f2e8ac5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p]Survivor lives now persist across the match. Players who reconnect return with the same lives they had before disconnecting.[/p][/*][*][p]Players who rejoin with zero lives cannot select a survivor that is still alive.[/p][/*][*][p]Players joining mid-game cannot take a dead survivor slot if a living one is available.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Maps[/h2][list][*][p]Added Blood Altars to all maps (one guaranteed in the main corridor/room; others may appear randomly).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted collision to prevent objects from getting stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more puzzles across maps to reduce chances of puzzle shortages.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]Survivors can now see the remaining lives of other survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved voice chat feedback.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Escape door light now updates correctly for late-joining players.[/p][/*][*][p]Possible fix for Blight not attacking when too close.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed client updates after leaving the profile menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inconsistent breakable object pieces.[/p][/*][*][p]Possible fix for breakable objects not auto-picking up.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed buzzing sounds from lights that shouldn’t have them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential soft lock at Clandestine Hospital due to an incorrect spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed disappearing mouse when tutorial + chat were open.[/p][/*][*][p]Possible fix for puzzle letters not appearing on the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed valve rotation lock when survivors added valves too quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some puzzles floating.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inventory items not clearing when a player left the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed small issue with Blight’s energy bar UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Possible fix for profile window showing the wrong player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential soft lock with the Oracle’s Gemstone puzzle at the Missing Warehouse.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What’s Next[/h2][p]We’re already working on the next steps for Damned 2:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Game tutorial[/b] for new Damned players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blight rework[/b], making its gameplay more unique.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New puzzles[/b] to expand match variety.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New maps[/b] to explore and survive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Monster[/b] – a well-known character from Damned 1 will soon return to haunt your dreams.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’re excited to see how you use this new mechanic, and as always, keep sending us your feedback![/p]

notes.title: Damned 2 Early Access is Live!
notes.notes: [h2]Hey everyone![/h2][p][/p][p]After years of development, feedback, and sleepless nights, we're beyond excited (and a little terrified) to finally say it:[/p][p][/p][h3]🎉[b]Damned 2 is officially out in Early Access![/b]🎉[/h3][h3][/h3][p]We’re the same indie team behind the original [i]Damned[/i] (2014), and we’re proud to bring you a brand-new take on asymmetrical horror.[/p][p]In [i]Damned 2[/i], a group of [b]4 survivors[/b] must escape from a terrifying location while being hunted by [b]1 powerful monster[/b] — controlled by another player or AI. Your only tools are your wits, teamwork, and whatever you can find scattered throughout the map. Explore dark, cursed environments, solve puzzles, unlock doors, and stay one step ahead of the creature stalking you.[/p][p]Each match is different thanks to randomized puzzles, key locations, and item placement — making survival not just about skill, but adaptation and communication. Whether you're creeping down the halls of an abandoned hotel or sprinting through a creepy mortuary, danger is always just around the corner.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s included in the Early Access launch:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Nine fully playable maps.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Three deadly monsters:[/b] Lurker, Mary, and Blight![/p][/*][*][p][b]Eight unique puzzles[/b], key randomization, and procedural item placement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Online multiplayer with voice chat.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Original Soundtrack by Matt Collins[/b] (composer of Damned 1).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]And most importantly… [b]chaos.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We'll be sharing our [b]roadmap soon[/b], and your feedback will help shape what's next.[/p][p][/p][h3]Why your voice matters[/h3][p]We're a tiny indie team — just two people — and this game wouldn’t exist without the support and passion of our community. This Early Access phase is a crucial time for us. Your bug reports, gameplay feedback, balance suggestions, and crazy ideas are incredibly valuable to help us refine the experience.[/p][p]So please, dive in, test the game, break things, and tell us what you find![/p][list][*][p]Chat with us directly on [b]Discord[/b] and in the [b]Community Hub[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Share clips, tag us, and spread the word[/p][/*][*][p]Leave a review if you’re enjoying the experience[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Thank you ❤️[/h3][p]From the bottom of our hearts, thank you to everyone who’s followed this project, tested it, sent us feedback, shared excitement, or just cheered us on. We're building [i]Damned 2[/i] alongside you, and we can't wait to see what you'll do with it.[/p][p][/p][p]See you… in the dark. 🔦[/p][p]— Daniel & Henrique[/p][p][i]9heads Games[/i][/p]

notes.title: Damned 2 Final Playtest Announcement!
notes.notes: [h3]Hello Everyone![/h3][p][/p][p]We are excited to finally announce our final playtest before [b]Early Access![/b][/p][p]The playtest will take place from [b]July 3rd to July 7th[/b], and you’ll be able to try out new maps, meet the new survivors, explore new mechanics, and what you've all been waiting for… [b][i][u]The Blight![/u][/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/eb71cd1bc8b41a3f999e158b269586bf57742415.png"][/img][/p][p]The Blight is now among us! Ready to lunge and leap, survivors must now be extra weary of their surroundings, all while slowly unlocking their escape. Able to manipulate and absorb light from the environment (yes, even your flashlights!), the Blight is a monster that preys on the one thing you treasure most - light. Survivors must now be extra careful, as their reprieve now fuels the Blight in various ways.[/p][p][/p][p]But to face this new, fearsome entity, are two new survivors. [b][i][u]Meet Mother Lucy and Mac![/u][/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/136a7da188edffd13c70245afa94b94f00bf59d6.png"][/img][/p][p]A close friend of our beloved Father John (Damned 1), [b]Mother Lucy[/b] joins the survivors to search for clues about her dear friend’s mysterious disappearance. What happened to John at Rose Crimson then, 13 years ago? Will Mother Lucy find the answers to her many questions? Bearer of the Light, Mother Lucy is a clever and courageous woman - afraid of no demon, she is ready to light the path for fellow survivors in their quest for truth.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Mac[/b] - [i]short for MacAllister[/i] - joins his friends Lily and Lucas along accompanying survivors in the nightmare. Other than yearning for munchies, Mac steps out of his comfort zone in his pursuit of answers relating to his father, the illegal scientific experiments he got involved in, and the letters Mac had recently started receiving in his name.[/p][p][/p][p]This playtest also introduces a brand-new map: [/p][p][b][i][u]The Ashen Mortuary.[/u][/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/745fb6b42aa385293daf233e59f0e3a7df58084c.png"][/img][/p][p]The Ashen Mortuary is a towering building, housing dozens of valuable pottery and vases, rumored to store stashed goods from previous survivors, but beware… the darkness hears everything. Explore the old, decrepit mortuary slow and steady, and watch your step, as you wouldn't want to fall with [i]no railing![/i][/p][p][/p][p]And before we end this announcement, we want to thank our amazing community for helping us turn [b]Damned 2[/b] into a worthy successor to the pioneer of the asymmetrical horror genre - as a token of appreciation, everyone who joins the playtest will receive a exclusive player Banner. [/p][p][/p][p]join this upcoming Damned 2 playtest and receive access to the exclusive [b]Crash Test Banner[/b] (made available on launch), symbolizing your bravery in testing and reporting the most terrifying bugs that haunt developers and players alike in multiplayer games. Seriously, bug-fixing has us feeling Damned in real life sometimes.[/p][p][/p][p] Introducing: the [b][i][u]Crash Test Banner![/u][/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/2f02f38bc41cc01a2a598dd3950924be7bef131d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][i][u]See you in the final playtest! [/u][/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Damned 2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm Daniel, co-founder of 9Heads games. Today I'm very happy to announce that Damned 2 entered the pre-production phase.

If you wish to know more about this new sequel, you can access Damned 2 steam page here.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221390/Damned_2/

Over the past 10 years, Damned fans kept it alive. A Discord channel was created to concentrate players that loved Damned, players that wish to complete all achievements, or new players looking for others to play with. 

Now its time to move forward again, and bring Damned to the new generation of players and PCs. Damned 2 is being developed in Unreal Engine 5, with amazing graphics and new gameplay mechanics. 

The core essence of the game still the same, simple mechanics, exploration, and lots of jump scares! But this time we are bringing new elements to it, like puzzles, integrated VOIP and monster abilities.

If you wish to take part in the development, by discussing gameplay ideas, mechanics, and new stuff that you would like to see in Damned 2, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/GJYaRkWACG]Discord server[/url]. We are often looking for new people to test our builds and help us finding bugs. 

I would like to thank all Damned fans, that kept sending me messages about new content or a sequel, we hear you!

Damned 2 will better and greater then ever!

notes.title: Community Patch Notes V001
notes.notes:
[h1]Community Patch V001[/h1]


[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a new Community-made Map 'Pog Champ Hotel'
[*]Added a new Community-made Map 'Hund Hills Community Center'
[*]Debug Console now displays a list of Maps and their internal ID
[*]Pressing ESCAPE Button while in Lobby should no longer exit the lobby (fixes a bug that leads to GUI Layout breaking)
[*]Wooden Planks no longer turn invisible when loosened (and can be dragged around once again)
[/list]


[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]


[b]Lurker:[/b]
[list]
[*]monster_close.ogg is now Global (instead of previous 20m Range)
[/list]

[b]Phantom:[/b]
[list]
[*]monster_around.ogg plays when Phantom is within 12m of the Player
[*]monster_around.ogg edited for clarity purposes
[*]Changed background music when you are survivor and Phantom sees you from 'Run!' (monster_closer) to 'Kill!' (blind_hearing)
[*]blind_hearing.ogg edited, smoothened looping and added an ease-in at the beginning
[/list]

[b]Fallen:[/b]
[list]
[*]All Maps received an individual Trap Probability Modifier when playing as Fallen - various maps will have varying ammount of active clickable Traps for Fallen in specific.
[*]Activating a Trap while in Trapper Form (P1) will now display progress until Seeker Form (P2) in the top left of the screen
[*]Trapper Form (P1) Movement Speed Multiplier now 1.65 (was 1.0)
[*]Needed Traps for Seeker Form (P2) now 16
[*]Max possible Statues is now 8 (16 on Woods) (was 5 normally, 10 on Woods)
[*]Seeker Form (P2) can now see Humans
[*]Seeker Form (P2) starts transforming to Destroyer Form (P3) when a Survivor is within 6m line-of-sight, instead of previous 10m
[*]Destroyer Form (P3) now lasts for 30s (was 7s)
[*]Fallen now has a new Ability:
While in Destroyer Form, press E button to phase out of Destroyer into Trapper Form and revert back into Destroyer after 4s assuming your 30s Form Time didn't elapse yet.
This ability has a cooldown of 5s (9s if you count the 4s of phasing time).
[/list]

[b]Insanity System:[/b]
[list]
[*]Clicking on closed Objects no longer increases Insanity
[*]'Sound Hallucination' Insanity Effect can now play monster-related noises
[/list]


[h1]Maps[/h1]

[b]Black Lake Asylum:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added more Traps
[*]Fixed an issue where the 3 conjoined offices were not alligned with the hallway properly.
[/list]

[b]Black Lake Woods:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added more Traps
[*]Using Bolt Cutter on the Barn Chains will now correctly say "Item Bolt Cutter used to cut a chain"
[/list]

[b]Bodom Hotel:[/b]
[list]
[*]Floating handkerchief box in ladies restroom no longer floating
[*]Fixed 1 Key Sequence that made the Map unsolvable unless you had people spawn on the other side of the map
[/list]

[b]Bright Hotel:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added more Traps
[*]Adjusted the position of tables and chairs in the Dining Room for more smoother movement around the room
[/list]

[b]Factory:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added more Traps
[*]Made Human Starting Area feel less empty
[*]Adjusted Ladders that were previously underground to a degree
[*]Adjusted multiple object spawnpoints on tables so they do not glitch
[*]Fixed a visual where light cords were sticking through a floor from a room below
[/list]

[b]Hund Hills Asylum:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted some visuals in the Kitchen
[/list]

[b]Pines Grill Restaurant:[/b]
[list]
[*]Moved an ouija board near the pianos to be propped up against them instead of on the middle of the floor (so mary can walk by more easily)
[*]Moved an ouija board in the 2nd dining hall off the floor and onto a table (so that mary can walk by more easily)
[/list]

[b]Rose Crimson Hotel:[/b]
[list]
[*]Unstuck the little cupboard door in the Spawn Room. Also fixes a Key Sequence that was previously unsolvable.
[*]Repositioned the single-door leading out of the Human Spawn Room, as it would sometimes become stuck, and now it no longer should.
[*]Moved an ouija board in the pantry on the floor onto a box (so that mary may walk by more easily)
[*]Moved Mary spawnpoint from a stall in the womens restroom to another stall (so that she can easily get out)
[*]Adjusted a collision spot with 2 randomized casks
[/list]

[b]Serenity Asylum:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added more Traps
[*]Created a miniature makeshift passage on the 2nd floor and aligned room A101 to it (this was done because room A101 originally clipped through the staircase leading to the 3rd floor, and thus the exit, but mary could not walk over it. these changes were to make it so that she can)
[/list]

[b]Tygerberg Hospital:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added more Traps
[*]Adjusted collision in one of the rooms that was previously preventing Lurker and Mary from passing
[/list]

[b]Warehouse:[/b]

This map originally had a poor distribution of traps (some traps being grouped up in clusters of up to 8 at a time) and as such been moderately reworked.
In total, Warehouse now has 3 less traps.
[list]
[*]8 Grandfather Clocks replaced with non-trap variants (in the clock room)
[*]5 Oven Timers removed, 4 traps added (in the Human Spawn Room)
[*]10 Pianos replaced with 10 non-trap variants, 3 traps added (in the Piano/Safe Tower Room)
[*]12 traps added to Closet Room (Room before the Clock Room, which originally had 2 traps)
[/list]

notes.title: New updates starting this week!
notes.notes:
Whats up everybody!

We have some nice features coming this week, starting today!

First of all, we've added a little Halloween touch in the maps. Jack o' Lanterns and stuff!

Today's patch will include bug fixing, balancing and some new scene assets (lot of new changes in the Hospital). And later this week we'll release a little Halloween treat for you guys (Yes, this week!), guess what? Voice chat!

We've put a lot of effort into making voice chat really fun. 

It means...

- The sound is 3D positional, even people using stereo speakers/headset will have great precision telling where the sound is coming from. 
- Distance attenuation and physics based attenuation! If you go too far from your buddies, its gonna be hard for you guys to communicate or even impossible because there is also physics based attenuation. Meaning that if you are behind doors, objects, walls, and any other physical barrier the sound will be attenuated too, just as it should ;)

And what about the monsters!?!?!

Yeah, here is the fun part. While playing Lurker, you're gonna be able to hear and speak while in its physical form. Time to hear those little invaders screaming out of loud!

For now the Phantom won't be able to hear voice chat, that's where you guys can help us, we need help deciding how to make voice chat work with Phantom without breaking the game or making him too over-powered.

So if you have some good ideas and suggestion on how to make the voice chat work with phantom, please discuss it with us in the forums! 

That's it for now, hope you guys enjoy the new features to come.

notes.title: Now Available - Damned
notes.notes:
Damned is Now Available on Steam

Damned is a randomized online horror game for up to 5 players (4 survivors and 1 monster).

You’ll be able to play as one of four people trapped in different haunted places (hotels, hospitals, etc).

As a survivor your main objective will be finding your way out, as well as helping your friends get out too. You’ll often find yourself on the edge, hearing and seeing ghostly things, trying to find keys and items to help in your escape. And sometimes you’ll find yourself running desperately from a monster, who’s there only to find and kill you and your friends.

You’ll also be able to play as the monster. The game will feature different monsters, each one unique in its gameplay and hunting style.
